scope: Primary-source literature consulted; external results are not AirLLM Next measurements and have not been independently reproduced here.

papers.title: Fast Inference from Transformers via Speculative Decoding
papers.authors: Yaniv Leviathan, Matan Kalman, Yossi Matias
papers.relevance: Target verification permits output-preserving speculation under the required verification/sampling rules. The local engine implements a narrower exact greedy contract, not the paper's complete stochastic sampler.

papers.title: Accelerating Mixture-of-Experts Inference by Hiding Offloading Latency with Speculative Decoding
papers.relevance: SpecMoEOff couples verification width with per-expert work and offloading costs. It motivates measuring full generation latency including draft and verification overhead rather than expert read count alone.

papers.title: Utility-Driven Speculative Decoding for Mixture-of-Experts
papers.authors: Anish Saxena, Po-An Tsai, Hritvik Taneja, Aamer Jaleel, Moinuddin Qureshi
papers.relevance: Cascade observes that speculation can activate many additional experts and become slower. It motivates testing zero-depth greedy fallbacks and adapting speculation to observed service time per emitted token.

papers.title: SP-MoE: Speculative Decoding and Prefetching for Accelerating MoE-based Model Inference
papers.authors: Liangkun Chen, Zijian Wen, Tian Wu, Xiaoxi Zhang, Chuan Wu
papers.relevance: Bounded prefetch and overlapped expert offloading can complement speculation. Draft-based routing predictions remain hints: actual target routing is the only authority for execution, and wasted prefetch must be charged.

papers.title: FlashMoE: Reducing SSD I/O Bottlenecks via ML-Based Cache Replacement for Mixture-of-Experts Inference on Edge Devices
papers.authors: Byeongju Kim, Jungwan Lee, Donghyeon Han, Hoi-Jun Yoo, Sangyeob Kim
papers.relevance: A learned combination of recency and frequency motivates trace-driven admission/replacement comparisons. Its reported hit rates or speedups cannot be transferred to GLM-5.3 on this user's 16 GB M5.

papers.title: SSD-LLaMA: SSD-Native Inference for Trillion-Parameter MoE at 1+ Token/s on a Consumer PC
papers.authors: Fangzhou Liang, Yibin Shen, Jianmin Hu, Jiayang Xu, Hanchi Gao, Minxian Xu, Zili Meng
papers.relevance: A recent three-tier SSD/RAM/VRAM design executes selected experts without pruning and coordinates expert delivery. Its single RTX 5090 and up-to-32 GB RAM setting differs materially from an M5 Air with 16 GB unified memory; throughput claims are not a validation of this engine.

papers.title: SSD Offloading for LLM Mixture-of-Experts Weights Considered Harmful in Energy Efficiency
papers.authors: Kwanhee Kyung, Sungmin Yun, Jung Ho Ahn
papers.relevance: Latency hiding alone does not remove storage traffic or its energy cost. Physical/logical read counters and sustained energy/thermal experiments remain distinct from wall-clock speedup.
